text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d l-a-b r-e-p-o-r-t-s, l-e-f-t f-o-r-g-e-d d-r-a-f-t e-d-i-t-s o-n t-h-e d-e-s-k-t-o-p, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y r-e-v-e-w.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d f-a-k-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-o-s, l-e-f-t s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t-s o-f t-h-e f-a-k-e m-a-r-k-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d a-g-e w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s o-n p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g, l-e-f-t b-u-n-d-l-e-s o-f o-l-d s-t-i-c-k-e-r-s i-n t-h-e s-t-o-c-k r-o-o-m, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-h-i-p-p-e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y t-o r-e-t-a-i-l e-a-r-l-y, l-e-f-t l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s w-i-t-h n-o d-e-f-e-c-t n-o-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y h-o-l-d a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-s-g-d t-h-e t-e-a-m t-o "h-e-l-d" t-h-e i-s-s-u-e, l-e-f-t c-h-a-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y o-f t-h-e i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e.
